Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "Tournament Participants", "DB Saga" or "Youth" Category allies'
Ki +2, ATK 20%{passiveImg:up_g} and DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g}, plus an additional Ki +1 and
ATK & DEF 20%{passiveImg:up_g} for characters who also belong to the
"World Tournament" Category
*When HP is 90% or less, when 3 or more "Tournament Participants",
"DB Saga" or "Youth" Category allies are on the team, or when
2 or more "World Tournament" Category allies are on the team*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of performing a critical hit & chance of evading enemy's
attack 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When HP is 70% or less, when 4 or more "Tournament Participants",
"DB Saga" or "Youth" Category allies are on the team, or when
3 or more "World Tournament" Category allies are on the team*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of performing a critical hit & damage reduction rate 50%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- ATK 500%{passiveImg:up_g} when HP is 50% or less, when 5 or more
"Tournament Participants", "DB Saga" or "Youth" Category
allies are on the team, or when 4 or more "World Tournament"
Category allies are on the team
*When there is a "Tournament Participants", "DB Saga" or "Youth"
Category enemy*
- ATK 300%{passiveImg:up_g} and DEF 400%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking
- {passiveImg:once}Chance of evading enemy's attack 40%{passiveImg:up_g} as the
1st attacker in a turn
